summary: Iteration 1 — Klinara Kids: Ran 20 pytest backend tests (all passing after 2 MongoDB fixes) and smoke-tested 4 critical frontend flows via Playwright (Parent OTP, Admin, MD, Teacher). All login flows and primary dashboards render correctly with real backend data.

minor.issue: Motor client was not tz_aware, causing naive-vs-aware datetime TypeErrors on OTP verify and password reset — fixed by passing tz_aware=True

POST /api/students auto-creating parent failed with DuplicateKey on email index (explicit email:null + legacy non-sparse index). Fixed by (a) dropping/recreating email index as sparse, (b) omitting email field instead of setting null in create_student and seed

issues: Archetype currently shows 'TEST_Archetype' (left over from backend pytest running POST /api/elthea/complete on the seeded student). Main agent should re-seed or skip in tests; or T1 test should use a throwaway student.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warnings in console: 'shadow*' style props (use boxShadow), Image style.resizeMode (use props.resizeMode), props.pointerEvents (use style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking but should be cleaned up.

action_items: Restore Aarav's original Elthea archetype ('The Explorer') after backend tests polluted it — either re-run seed with reset, or modify /api/elthea/complete test to use a throwaway student.
(Optional) Clean up deprecated RN style props (shadow*, resizeMode, pointerEvents) to remove console warnings.
(Optional) Add partialFilterExpression on the users.email index ({email: {$type: 'string'}}) for defense in depth — current sparse index works now that null fields are omitted.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 860 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth.py, students.py, payments.py, etc.) when project grows.
CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False is fine for token auth, but lock down to EXPO_PACKAGER_HOSTNAME for prod.

create_student auto-creates a parent without phone uniqueness enforcement beyond a sparse index — could create dupes if parent was already registered with different casing/whitespace. Consider strip/normalize phone before lookup.
No rate-limit on /auth/parent/send-otp — a caller could spam OTP generation for any registered phone.

rca_of_issue: Two backend defects found and fixed in this iteration: (1) Motor AsyncIOMotorClient defaults tz_aware=False, so datetimes stored tz-aware were returned naive; comparisons like `rec['expires_at'] < now_utc()` raised TypeError and returned 500 (visible on /api/auth/parent/verify-otp when invalid OTP, and /api/auth/reset-password). Fix: tz_aware=True. (2) users.email unique index was not sparse on the existing DB, and create_student+seed stored email as explicit null; MongoDB treats null as a value, so inserting a second parent failed with DuplicateKey. Fix: drop/recreate index as sparse in seed() + stop writing email:null (omit the key when unknown). Both fixes applied and re-verified.
